affinity.notes: The storm is environmental; the sovereign and attendants remain visibly feathered, armored physical creatures.

archetype.notes: Aerial commander and summoner communicates the storm-court sovereign duty.

counterplay.notes: The command tableau implies summons or coordination, but it shows neither a distinct attack telegraph nor an obvious vulnerable or recovery state.

finish.notes: Coherent storm palette and detailed feather treatment.

framing.notes: Four secondary figures compete with the intended unit and make the token read as an encounter group.

identity.notes: Harpy queen identifies the Sky Queen form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
